referenceGradeRationale: WoRMS and the peer-reviewed Japanese atyid revision anchor the accepted species name, diagnostic morphology and river habitat. The Okinawa institutional account supplies a 3 to 5 cm size range and mottled reddish-brown appearance. Lateral colour and fine appendage detail remain candidate-build questions, so no asset is built or promoted here.
